item.tib: gtsug gtor gdugs dkar po can gyi phyi mtshams tho bzhi'i rim pa
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub phyir bzlog pa rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud las/ phyi mtshams tho bzhi'i rim pa 'di yang rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing gi ngo mtshar gling du kho bo kun grol grags pas dus kyi pho nya'i zla tshes bzang nyin du sbyar ba 'di yang mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyan gyur cig gi smon pa dang bcas pa ithi//
